sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: RATHER MODEST MOISTURE LEVELS LIKELY REMAIN A LIMITING FACTOR TO MORE SUBSTANTIVE SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL. BUT MOST MODEL GUIDANCE CONTINUES TO SUGGEST THAT LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION...ACCOMPANYING A STRENGTHENING MID-LEVEL SHORT WAVE IMPULSE SHIFTING EAST OF THE NORTHERN ROCKIES...WILL BECOME SUPPORTIVE OF THE EVOLUTION OF A CLUSTER OF STORMS OVERNIGHT. THIS SEEMS LIKELY TO COMMENCE DURING THE 03-06Z TIME FRAME... ROUGHLY NEAR THE WESTERN NORTH/SOUTH DAKOTA BORDER AREA...FOCUSED WITHIN STRONGER LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION ON THE NORTHERN FRINGE OF MORE STRONGLY CAPPING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR ADVECTING EAST NORTHEASTWARD FROM THE NORTH CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. DEEP LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR ASSOCIATED WITH A 50+ KT WESTERLY 500 MB JET STREAK NOSING ACROSS THE DAKOTAS WILL BE MORE THAN SUFFICIENT FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF AN ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM IN THE PRESENCE OF STEEP LAPSE RATES AND AT LEAST WEAK TO MODERATE CAPE. IN ADDITION TO THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...SIZABLE SUB-CLOUD TEMPERATURE/DEW POINTS SPREADS COUPLED WITH SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL JET INTENSIFICATION /IN EXCESS OF 50-60+ KT AT 850 MB/ MAY CONTRIBUTE TO INCREASING POTENTIAL FOR STRONG DAM

sections.title: N CNTRL TEXAS
sections.text: SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT CONTINUES NEAR THE DALLAS/FORT WORTH METROPLEX...MAINLY ALONG A RESIDUAL CONVECTIVELY GENERATED OR ENHANCED SURFACE BOUNDARY...SUPPORTED BY SIZABLE CAPE /2000-3000 MIXED LAYER/ AND MODERATELY STRONG VERTICAL ASSOCIATED WITH A 30-40 KT NORTHWESTERLY 500 MB SPEED MAXIMUM ACCOMPANYING A CONVECTIVELY GENERATED MID-LEVEL CYCLONIC VORTEX. SLIGHT RISK PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN ADDED TO PARTS OF NORTH CENTRAL TEXAS ...WHERE ACTIVITY MAY PERSIST FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO. BEYOND 03-04Z...SEVERE POTENTIAL BECOMES MORE UNCLEAR...AS BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING AND STABILIZATION MAY BECOME MORE PROMINENT...AND THE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE CONTINUES TO SLOWLY DIG SOUTH OF THE SURFACE BOUNDARY.

sections.title: SOUTHWEST TEXAS
sections.text: A FEW SUPERCELLS ARE ONGOING ACROSS THE DAVIS MOUNTAINS AREA OF SOUTHWEST TEXAS. STORM-SCALE DYNAMIC FORCING MAY HELP MAINTAIN CONVECTION AT LEAST INTO THE 02-03Z TIME FRAME...BEFORE INCREASING MID-LEVEL INHIBITION WITH BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING SUPPRESSES ACTIVITY. ..KERR.. 06/14/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS ANTICIPATED WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO WITHIN ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED MULTICELLS AND SOME SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT TRENDS IN VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOW DEEPENING CUMULUS CONVECTION ALONG THE SANGRE DE CRISTO MOUNTAINS WITH AN ADDITIONAL AGITATED CUMULUS FIELD NOTED ALONG THE TX/NM BORDER NE TCC. THESE OBSERVATIONS ARE CONSISTENT WITH LATEST RAP GUIDANCE WHICH SHOWS A WEAKNESS IN THE CAP ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA WITH MLCAPE VALUES NOW APPROACHING 1500-2500 J/KG. CONTINUED BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING AND GROWING INFLUENCE OF SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH THE SRN ROCKIES ARE EXPECTED TO FOSTER ISOLATED-WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS BY 21-22Z IN EITHER OR BOTH AREAS MENTIONED ABOVE. AREA VAD/PROFILER DATA AND MODEL-DERIVED FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THAT GENERALLY WEAK MIDLEVEL FLOW /I.E. 15-20 KT AT 500 MB/ WILL LIMIT DEEP-LAYER SHEAR MAGNITUDE TO 30 KT OR LESS. HOWEVER...THE PRESENCE OF A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE AND THE MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL STILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF ROBUST UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..MEAD.. 06/13/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM COVERAGE AND AN ACCOMPANYING THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN UPSTREAM UPPER IMPULSE POSITIONED OVER WRN AZ /PER RECENT WATER VAPOR LOOP/ IS SLOWLY TRANSLATING EWD...WITH AN ACCOMPANYING BAND OF INFERRED ASCENT SPREADING INTO SRN NM. VWP DATA FROM HDX ALSO INDICATES MIDLEVEL WLY FLOW MAY BE ENHANCED /30-40 KTS ABOVE 5 KM AGL/ IN THE VICINITY OF THIS IMPULSE...AND IS STRONGER THAN MOST NUMERICAL MODEL FORECASTS INDICATE. MEANWHILE...STRONG DAYTIME HEATING IS OCCURRING OVER FAR W TX AND SERN NM DESPITE THE PRESENCE OF SCT MIDLEVEL CLOUDS...WITH TEMPERATURES REACHING THE UPPER 80S TO LOWER 90S. VISIBLE SATELLITE LOOP SHOWS POCKETS OF TOWERING CU OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN /INCLUDING THE SACRAMENTO...GUADALUPE...AND DAVIS MTNS/...AND WITH CONTINUED HEATING AND THE APPROACH OF THE UPSTREAM UPPER IMPULSE...THE POTENTIAL FOR DEVELOPING STRONG TO POSSIBLY SVR STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE. LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ADVECTION CONTINUES TO BE AIDED BY 30 KTS OF 0-1 KM SSELY FLOW /PER MAF VWP/ INTO THE HIGH PLAINS OF SERN NM. AFTERNOON. THIS WILL RESULT IN FAVORABLE...VEERING WIND PROFILES...AND MLCAPE VALUES EXCEEDING 1500 J/KG...SUFFICIENT FOR ISOLATED SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTIVE INITIATION IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY LIKELY WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. AN ACCOMPANYING THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS WILL LIKELY REQUIRE WW ISSUANCE BY 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 19Z SFC ANALYSIS PLACES A COLD FRONT ACROSS FAR ERN MT/WY...MOVING EWD INTO A PROGRESSIVELY MORE MOIST/UNSTABLE AIR MASS ACROSS THE WRN DAKOTAS. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATES BUILDING CU FIELD ALONG THE COLD FRONT...AS WELL AS OVER THE BLACK HILLS...AS STRONG HEATING HAS ALLOWED TEMPERATURES TO REACH THE UPPER 70S/LOWER 80S. MEANWHILE...ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH AN UPSTREAM UPPER TROUGH AND ATTENDANT SPEED MAX NOSING INTO THE NRN PLAINS WILL ENHANCE THE POTENTIAL FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. SFC OBS INDICATE MOST NUMERICAL GUIDANCE /INCLUDING LATEST VERSIONS OF THE RAP/ IS UNDERESTIMATING BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE...AND SUBSEQUENTLY AMOUNT OF AVAILABLE CAPE. MODIFIED FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THAT SBCAPE VALUES OF AROUND 1500 J/KG ARE PRESENT. COMBINED WITH FAVORABLE VEERING WIND PROFILES /YIELDING EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES GREATER THAN 40 KTS/ AND INCREASING FORCED ASCENT ACCOMPANYING THE AFOREMENTIONED UPPER TROUGH...THE POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS...AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO...WILL LIKELY REQUIRE ISSUANCE OF A WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING OVER PORTIONS OF NRN TX MAY POSE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ATTM...COVERAGE IS NOT EXPECTED TO BE GREAT ENOUGH FOR A WW...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS AN MCV MOVING EWD ALONG THE RED RIVER THIS EVENING...WITH ENHANCED CUMULUS DEVELOPMENT NOTED ALONG ITS SRN PERIPHERY IN AND AROUND THE DALLAS/FORT WORTH METRO AREA. IN ADDITION...KFWS NEXRAD AT 2145Z SHOWS AN ISOLATED STORM HAS INITIATED N OF DALLAS. ACARS SOUNDING SAMPLING THE LOCAL ENVIRONMENT INDICATES THE PRESENCE OF A WEAKENING CAP...STRONG INSTABILITY AND STRONGLY VEERING WIND PROFILE AND SHEAR...FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT INCLUDING SUPERCELLS. THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL FAVOR A CONDITIONAL RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS INTO THE EARLY NIGHT. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS ECNTRL AND SE SD THIS EVENING. THE PRIMARY THREATS WITH THE CONVECTION SHOULD BE STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. THE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN MARGINAL AND WW ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS SHOWS A 1000 MB LOW NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF WY...MT AND SD WITH A THERMAL AXIS EXTENDING NWD INTO CNTRL SD WHERE TEMPS ARE IN THE MID 90S F. THE THERMAL AXIS INTERSECTS A POCKET OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IN THE HURON AREA WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE LOWER 60S F. THESE FACTORS ARE HELPING TO CREATE MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS THE MCD AREA WITH MLCAPE VALUES ESTIMATED IN THE 200O TO 2500 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...MESOANALYSIS SUGGESTS THE CAPPING INVERSION HAS WEAKENED ACROSS SCNTRL SD. THIS COMBINED WITH A SMALL AREA OF INCREASED LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND SFC HEATING HAS ENABLED THUNDERSTORMS TO INITIATE JUST TO THE SOUTHEAST OF PIERRE OVER THE LAST HOUR. SHORT-TERM MODEL FORECASTS SUGGEST THIS ACTIVITY WILL REMAIN ISOLATED EARLY THIS EVENING BUT LARGE TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS MAY HELP ENHANCE DOWNDRAFTS ENOUGH FOR A FEW MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS. THE CAPPING INVERSION IS FORECAST TO RESTRENGTHEN AFTER 03Z WHICH SHOULD MAKE THE CONVECTION MORE ELEVATED IN NATURE. HOWEVER...AS THE LOW-LEVEL JET STRENGTHENS THIS EVENING...CONVECTION MAY REDEVELOP ACROSS WCNTRL SD AND MOVE EWD INTO THE AREA FROM THE WEST CONTINUING THE SEVERE THREAT DURING THE MID TO LATE EVENING. ..BROYLES.. 06/13/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SVR THUNDERSTORMS WILL LIKELY PERSIST DURING THE NEXT FEW HRS OVER PORTIONS OF NRN TX...POSING A THREAT FOR MAINLY LARGE/VERY LARGE HAIL. AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST COMPOSITE AND HI-RES RADAR IMAGERY INDICATES SUPERCELL OVER ERN DALLAS COUNTY HAS DISSIPATED...WHILE STORM OVER SWRN DALLAS COUNTY PERSISTS AS IT MOVES INTO ELLIS COUNTY. ADDITIONAL DISCRETE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED NEWD OVER COLLIN AND FANNIN COUNTIES CLOSER TO MCV CIRCULATION...AND IS MOVING S-SEWD AT 25 KT. THE 00Z FWD RAOB SHOWS THE PRESENCE OF A VERY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT...WITH AN MUCAPE VALUE NEAR 4000 J/KG AND 700-500 MB LAPSE RATE OF 7.5 C/KM. THIS THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT COMBINED WITH LOW-LEVEL E-SELYS VEERING TO NWLY IN THE MIDLEVELS WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT SUPERCELLS DURING THE NEXT FEW HRS POSING A THREAT FOR LARGE/VERY LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. CONSIDERABLE UNCERTAINTY EXISTS REGARDING CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION AND TRENDS...PARTICULARLY WITH STORM PERSISTENCE AND INTENSITY. GIVEN THIS UNCERTAINTY...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW...WITH THE PROBABILITY OF A WATCH INCREASING IF STORMS CAN MERGE AND ORGANIZE INTO AN MCS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES FOR WW 387...PRIMARILY FOR SRN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH OVER SWRN TX.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: COMPOSITE RADAR IMAGERY AT 0145Z SHOWS SEVERAL SUPERCELLS MOVING SEWD ACROSS SRN PORTIONS OF WW 387 IN SWRN TX...WITH NO OTHER STORMS LOCATED TO THE N OVER SERN NM. THE 00Z DRT AND MAF RAOBS AS WELL AS OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS GUIDANCE SHOW THE PRESENCE OF VERY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND SUBSTANTIAL MUCAPE /AOA 2500 J PER KG/ LOCATED OVER SWRN TX...WHICH WILL FAVOR STORM PERSISTENCE AND A THREAT FOR LARGE/VERY LARGE HAIL DURING THE NEXT FEW HRS. HOWEVER...BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING AND STABILIZATION WILL LEAD TO A STRENGTHENING CAP WITH TIME...AND MAY REDUCE THE SVR WEATHER THREAT GIVEN THE LACK OF STRONG MESOSCALE AND SYNOPTIC-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT. OTHERWISE...THE PROBABILITY FOR ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER SERN NM APPEARS TO BE LOW ATTM...AND THIS PORTION OF THE WATCH MAY BE CONSIDERED FOR CANCELLATION BEFORE THE 04Z EXPIRATION. ..GARNER.. 06/14/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE ACROSS PARTS OF ND AND SD LATE THIS EVENING EXTENDING INTO THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD. WIND DAMAGE AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS ALTHOUGH AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT CAN NOT BE RULED OUT LATER TONIGHT. WW ISSUANCE WILL BE NEEDED AS WW 386 EXPIRES DUE TO A CONTINUED SEVERE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC ANALYSIS CURRENTLY SHOWS A 998 MB LOW OVER SW SD WITH A COLD FRONT EXTENDING NWD THROUGH NW SD AND WRN ND. TO THE EAST OF THE FRONT...THE AIRMASS HAS POCKETS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH PEAK MLCAPE VALUES ESTIMATED TO BE AROUND 1000 TO 2000 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...THE BISMARK 00Z SOUNDINGS SHOWS AMPLE DIRECTIONAL SHEAR BELOW 700 MB WITH STRONG MID-LEVEL SPEED SHEAR WHICH IS CREATING ABOUT 45 KT O-6 KM SHEAR. THIS ALONG WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES THROUGH THE ENTIRE AIRMASS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS. THE CURRENT THINKING IS THAT THE ACTIVITY SOUTHWEST OF BISMARCK WILL CONTINUE TO MAINTAIN INTENSITY AND MAY EXPAND IN COVERAGE AS A BOWING LINE SEGMENT DEVELOPS LATE THIS EVENING. THIS LINE WILL BE SUPPORTED BY STRONG LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A NRN HIGH PLAINS UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH AND BY A STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET IN THE NRN PLAINS. AS THE LINE ORGANIZES OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...AN ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP EXTENDING ENEWD ACROSS THE MOBRIDGE...BISMARCK AND JAMESTOWN AREAS. LARGE HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY WITH SUPERCELLS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE. AN ISOLATED TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STORMS MAY BECOME MARGINALLY SEVERE WITH HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF STRONG STORMS HAS ARISEN ACROSS SERN TX IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE MCV OVER NRN LA. A VERY MOIST AIR MASS REMAINS IN PLACE AND LITTLE CIN IS PRESENT...THUS STORMS ARE FORMING WITH ONLY WEAK FORCING. OTHER STORMS WERE FORMING SE OF SPS WHERE A 30+ KT LLJ WAS CREATING LIFT OVER A WARM FRONT. SLY LOW LEVEL WINDS VEERING TO NWLY ALOFT IS RESULTING IN SUFFICIENT SHEAR PERHAPS FOR A FEW STORMS TO PERSIST. WHILE AN ORGANIZED THREAT OF SEVERE STORMS IS NOT ANTICIPATED...A FEW CORES MAY CONTAIN HAIL NEAR 1.00 INCH...HEAVY RAIN AND GUSTY WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MARGINAL HAIL APPEARS TO BE THE ONLY SEVERE THREAT IN AND CLOSE TO WW 388.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LINE OF STORMS OVER SERN ND HAS BECOME MORE ELEVATED WITH TIME AND THE WIND THREAT APPEARS TO BE DECREASING. MEANWHILE...CELLS HAVE BEEN REDEVELOPING ALONG THE SWRN FLANK OF THE DEEPER OUTFLOW ACROSS NERN SD...WHERE A 50+ KT SWLY LLJ WAS CREATING LIFT ATOP THE COLD DOME. WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES ALOFT SOME SHEAR IN THE CLOUD BEARING LAYER...A FEW OF THESE CELLS WILL BE CAPABLE OF MARGINAL HAIL NEAR 1.00 INCH. THE HAIL THREAT MAY PERSIST...AND SHIFT EWD WITH TIME ALONG WITH THE MAIN SYNOPTIC FRONT. A THREAT FOR MARGINAL HAIL WILL EXIST...BUT IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER IT WILL BE GREAT ENOUGH TO WARRANT AN ADDITIONAL WATCH FARTHER E. ..JEWELL.. 06/14/2012
